summary: CAST converts a value to another type, and ROUND controls how many decimals appear.
points: ROUND(value, 2) rounds to two decimal places. ROUND(value) rounds to a whole number.
CAST(value AS INTEGER) drops the decimals rather than rounding them.
CAST(value AS REAL) makes a division keep its decimals.
CAST(value AS TEXT) turns a number into text.

example.sql:
SELECT id, minutes, ROUND(CAST(minutes AS REAL) / 60, 2) AS hours
FROM sessions;
example.explanation: CAST prevents integer division, then ROUND keeps the result readable.
